text.en: Stop. The Chaos Mist has eaten every name on this gate.
text.zh: 且慢。混沌迷雾吃掉了这座城门上所有的名字。

text.en: A new voice must give a name before entering.
text.zh: 新来的声音，入城前必须留下名字。

text.en: Tell him: My name is {player_name}.
text.zh: 告诉他：My name is {player_name}。

text.en: Your name is clear now. The gate knows you.
text.zh: 你的名字清楚了。雾门认得你了。

text.en: Say it in a whole sentence: My name is ...
text.zh: 用一整句说：My name is ……

text.en: A name is not enough. Where do you live?
text.zh: 只有名字还不够。你住在哪里？

text.en: Answer him: I live in ... Say your own place.
text.zh: 回答他：I live in …… 说你自己住的地方就行。

text.en: Good. Now the gate remembers where you come from.
text.zh: 很好。现在雾门记得你从哪里来。

text.en: Two words are enough: I live ...
text.zh: 两个词就够了：I live ……

text.en: The mist wiped the words off your travel paper. Three pictures are left.
text.zh: 雾把你路引上的字抹掉了，只剩三幅图。

text.en: Picture one: many buildings, many streets, many people. What is it?
text.zh: 第一幅：许多楼房、许多街道、许多人。这是什么？

text.en: Say the word: city.
text.zh: 说出这个词：city。

text.en: City. The word is back on the paper. Its opposite is the country: fields, farms, few people.
text.zh: City。字回到路引上了。它的反面是 country：田野、农庄、人很少。

text.en: Try this word: city.
text.zh: 试试这个词：city。

text.en: Picture two: a road between the houses, with shops on both sides. What is it?
text.zh: 第二幅：房屋之间的一条路，两边都是店铺。这是什么？

text.en: Say the word: street.
text.zh: 说出这个词：street。

text.en: Street. Two more pictures to go.
text.zh: Street。还剩两幅图。

text.en: Try this word: street.
text.zh: 试试这个词：street。

text.en: Picture three: a tall thing with walls and windows, standing by the street. What is it?
text.zh: 第三幅：街边一个高高的东西，有墙有窗。这是什么？

text.en: Say the word: building.
text.zh: 说出这个词：building。

text.en: Building. Many people live in one building, in a flat.
text.zh: Building。很多人住在同一栋楼里，住的是 flat。

text.en: Try this word: building.
text.zh: 试试这个词：building。

text.en: Last picture: a small place with a door, where one family lives. Outside the city, a farm has one too. What is it?
text.zh: 最后一幅：一个小地方，有一扇门，住着一家人。城外农场上也有一个。这是什么？

text.en: Say the word: house.
text.zh: 说出这个词：house。

text.en: House. Your paper is clear. Flat, farm, house — the gate will know them all.
text.zh: House。你的路引清楚了。flat、farm、house，雾门都会认得了。

text.en: Try this word: house.
text.zh: 试试这个词：house。

text.en: One last question. Where is your home?
text.zh: 最后一个问题。你的家在哪里？

text.en: Answer him: My home is in ...
text.zh: 回答他：My home is in ……

text.en: Now the gate knows your name, your city, and your home. Wait here.
text.zh: 现在雾门知道你的名字、你的城、你的家。在这里等一等。

text.en: Say it like this: My home is in ...
text.zh: 这样说：My home is in ……

text.en: Two more learners are waiting here with you.
text.zh: 还有两位修习者也在这里等你。

text.en: Hi! I'm A-Ling. I live in Chang'an.
text.zh: 嗨！我是阿菱，我住在长安。

text.en: And I'm Haoran. My home is near the West Market.
text.zh: 我是昊然。我家就在西市附近。

text.en: You three will walk the West Market together.
text.zh: 你们三个会一起走西市。

text.en: Listen. The mist moved. Did you hear a bell?
text.zh: 听。雾动了。你听见钟声了吗？

text.en: That was the East Bell. It is asleep, and its voice is scattered in eight places. Only a voice like yours can wake it.
text.zh: 那是东皇钟。它睡着了，钟声散落在八个地方。只有像你这样的声音才能唤醒它。

text.en: Someone deeper in the city knows about the bell. A white-haired elder. Only he can tell us more.
text.zh: 城里有位白发老者知道这口钟。只有他能告诉我们更多。
